title: Beyond the Surface: Enhancing LLM-as-a-Judge Alignment with Human via Internal Representations
authors_zh: Peng Lai, Jianjie Zheng, Sijie Cheng, Yun Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu, Guanhua Chen
paper_type_zh: 评测器、验证器、奖励或基准可靠性研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Aggregates score-token logits across frozen transformer layers to improve point-wise judge alignment with humans.
聚合冻结 Transformer 各层的分数 token logit，以提升点式 LLM 评审与人工评分的一致性。
why: It makes the evaluator readout itself an auditable source of misalignment rather than treating final-token scores as fixed.
inclusion_reason: Audits point-wise LLM judging by testing whether intermediate representations improve human-score alignment.

title: Problem
问题
html: Point-wise LLM judges usually emit the most likely discrete score from the final decoder layer. That discards score-distribution uncertainty and can miss judgment-relevant information carried in intermediate representations. The paper asks whether a frozen judge can better align with human scalar ratings without a chain-of-thought prompt or backbone fine-tuning.
点式 LLM 评审通常只从最后一层取概率最大的离散分数，这会丢掉分数分布的不确定性，也忽略中间层携带的评判信息。论文检验：不使用思维链、不微调主干时，冻结评审能否借内部表征更贴近人工标量评分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LAGER reads score-token logits at every transformer layer, linearly aggregates them, softmaxes only over allowed scores, and returns the expected score. It can use equal layer weights or tune only L+1 weights on 1,000 held-out HelpSteer examples with CE+MAE while the judge remains frozen. Middle-upper layers provide complementary, more human-aligned evidence.
LAGER 在每个 Transformer 层读取候选分数 token 的 logit，线性聚合后仅在允许分数上 softmax，并以期望值输出细粒度分数。它可用等权重，也可在 1,000 条留出 HelpSteer 样本上以 CE+MAE 只训练 L+1 个层权重，主干保持冻结。关键依据是中上层含有与人工更一致的互补信息。

title: Method
方法
html: At the score position, LAGER collects the embedding and every layer's hidden state, projects each through the frozen LM head, and keeps only allowed score-token logits. It sums these raw logits with equal or learned layer weights, normalizes within the score set, and outputs the expected score. Only the L+1 weights are fitted with CE+MAE on 1,000 held-out HelpSteer instances; the judge, prompt, and next-token behavior remain fixed.
LAGER 在分数位置取嵌入层及每一层隐藏状态，经冻结 LM head 投影后只保留允许分数 token 的 logit；再按等权或学习到的层权重相加，仅在分数集合内归一化，并输出期望分数。训练时只在 1,000 条留出 HelpSteer 样本上用 CE+MAE 拟合 L+1 个权重，评审主干、提示词和原有下一 token 行为均不改变。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across FLASK, HelpSteer and BiGGen, tuned LAGER's mean Spearman correlation reaches 0.352/0.484/0.501/0.531/0.540/0.570 on six 7B--70B backbones. In the FLASK ablation, expected scoring, raw-logit aggregation and weight tuning jointly reach 0.545; tuning adds as much as 0.10 and expectation as much as 0.17. On Llama-3.1-8B, its FLASK score-distribution MSE is 0.060 versus 0.112 for direct scoring.

在 FLASK、HelpSteer 与 BiGGen 上，调权 LAGER 在六个 7B--70B 主干上的平均 Spearman 分别为 0.352、0.484、0.501、0.531、0.540、0.570。FLASK 消融中，期望分数、原始 logit 聚合和调权合用达到 0.545；调权最高增益 0.10，期望化最高增益 0.17。Llama-3.1-8B 上其分数分布 MSE 为 0.060，低于直接评分的 0.112。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Rather than prompting for reasoning or changing the evaluator's parameters, LAGER treats intermediate score-token logits as an ensemble of judgment signals. Its distinctive choice is to combine logits before the restricted softmax and expose a continuous expectation, showing that the last layer is not necessarily the best human-alignment readout.
LAGER 不依赖推理提示或修改评审参数，而把中间层的分数 token logit 视为一组评判信号。其关键选择是在受限 softmax 前聚合 logit、再给出连续期望分数，由此表明最后一层未必是与人工一致性最好的读出层。

title: Limitations
局限
html: LAGER needs white-box hidden states and therefore does not apply to closed APIs. Its calibrated weights depend on 1,000 human-labelled examples and compatible discrete score tokens. The experiments establish correlation on three scalar-rating suites, not robustness to prompt injection, reference manipulation, distribution shift, or a causal removal of evaluator bias.
LAGER 需要白盒隐藏状态，不能直接用于封闭 API；其层权重还依赖 1,000 条人工标注样本及兼容的离散分数 token。实验只证明它在三类标量评分集上提高相关性，未检验提示注入、参考答案操控、分布漂移，也未因果消除评审偏差。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For an open-weight evaluator audit, keep the backbone and prompt fixed, reserve a human-labelled calibration split, and compare last-layer, expected-score and cross-layer scores with confidence distributions. Re-run calibration after changing rubric or scale, and separately red-team prompt and reference sensitivity; the reported alignment gain alone is not a safety guarantee.
审计开源权重评审时，应固定主干和提示词，留出人工校准集，比较末层、期望分数与跨层分数及其置信分布。更换量表或 rubric 后要重新校准，并另行红队测试提示和参考答案敏感性；相关性提升本身不是安全保证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The useful audit contrast is direct scoring versus reasoning prompts: LAGER improves the former more reliably, while reasoning can degrade it. Check that the 1,000 tuning examples are held out from every reported test, preserve the score-token mapping, and log whether a result comes from equal weights or fitted weights. The paper releases code at https://github.com/sustech-nlp/LAGER.
值得审计的对照是直接评分与推理提示：LAGER 对前者更稳定，推理反而可能变差。应确认 1,000 条调权样本与所有测试集隔离，保存分数 token 映射，并记录结果来自等权还是拟合权重。代码见 https://github.com/sustech-nlp/LAGER。
